subjects.ticket: One tracker work item: an Azure DevOps or Jira URL, a Jira key (PROJ-123), AB#123, or a bare number.
subjects.pr: One pull request: an Azure DevOps or GitHub pull request URL, or #123 for the current repo's GitHub remote.
subjects.text: Pasted prose with no reference in it: rough requirements, meeting notes, a symptom, a story with its acceptance criteria.
subjects.file: A path to a document: notes, a transcript, a spec, a rough bug report.
subjects.source: A path or glob of UI source code.
subjects.none: No subject. The action works on the current sprint, a date range, or the whole checkout.

actions.label: Test it
actions.description: Runs it in a real browser like a senior QA: asks which test types to add to functional and navigation, then an adversarial test plan, execution with evidence, a Go / No-go report. Offers to file the bugs it finds.
intents: run the tests in the browser

next.when: the run found defects that are not filed, and the user was not asked about filing them during the run (bug-reporter was missing or filing is switched off)
next.subject: each unfiled defect as text: its title, steps, expected and actual, taken from the test report

actions.label: Triage it
actions.description: Full triage of any work item type: investigates, digs into the code on a Bug or Incident, refines the wording, sets severity or sprint, links related work. One gate before any write.

next.when: the item is a Story or Feature
next.subject: the same ticket

next.when: the change for this item is already built (the triage summary names a linked pull request, or the user said so)
next.subject: the same ticket

actions.label: Clean it up
actions.description: Rewrites the title and description of any work item type so it reads clearly. Cheap: no code dig, no field changes, no state change.

next.when: the item is a Story or Feature
next.subject: the same ticket

actions.label: Write acceptance tests
actions.description: Turns the story and its acceptance criteria into Gherkin feature files, and can create them as linked Test Cases behind a gate.

actions.label: Draft a test plan
actions.description: Read-only. Reconciles the ticket and its pull requests, asks which test types to add, and writes the edge-case test plan. Opens no browser.

next.subject: the same ticket or pull request

actions.label: Write the postmortem
actions.description: Gathers evidence for a resolved incident, rebuilds the timeline, and writes a blameless postmortem.

next.subject: the saved postmortem file when one was saved, otherwise its action items as text

actions.label: Rewrite as bug report
actions.description: Bug only. Restructures a vague existing bug into a complete report (steps, expected vs actual, severity) without losing a fact. One gate.

next.when: the run ended with Result: updated
next.subject: the same bug

next.when: the fix for this bug is already built (the user said so)
next.subject: the same bug

actions.label: Report a bug
actions.description: Files a complete Bug from a symptom: duplicate search, one clarification card, one gate. No investigation.

next.when: the run ended with Result: created, updated or duplicate-of
next.subject: the bug id on the Result line

actions.label: Draft user stories
actions.description: Turns rough requirements into INVEST user stories and creates the ones you pick, tagged Draft, behind one gate.

actions.label: Sprint status deck
actions.description: Read-only. Tallies the current sprint by state, flags blocked and stale items, and writes a Marp status deck.
actions.args: The sprint name and any flags the user typed, otherwise empty for the current sprint.

actions.label: Refresh Pulse dashboard
actions.description: Publishes or refreshes the private, always-current sprint dashboard Artifact.
actions.args: The sprint name and any flags the user typed, otherwise empty for the current sprint.

actions.label: What changed this sprint
actions.description: Read-only. Compares the sprint now against an earlier snapshot: shipped, newly started, scope added or dropped, new risk.
actions.args: The sprint name and any flags the user typed, otherwise empty for the current sprint.

actions.label: Summarize for clients
actions.description: Read-only. One plain-language line per ticket for a client update deck, for the tickets given or for a date range and status.
actions.args: Every ticket reference separated by spaces, or the user's flags verbatim (--range, --from, --till, --status, --tags, --to, --output). With no reference and no flags, ask which period first and pass the matching flags: --range this-week --status delivered, --range last-week --status delivered, or --status active.

actions.label: Review AC coverage
actions.description: Read-only. Reports how each acceptance criterion breaks down into testable behaviors, with gaps and open questions. Writes nothing.

actions.label: Preview a bug report
actions.description: Read-only. Prints the bug report that would be filed, including what is still missing. Nothing is created or changed.

next.when: the subject was text or a file
next.subject: the same input

actions.label: Audit test ids
actions.description: Read-only. Lists every interactive element in the UI source and which ones lack a data-testid.
intents: which elements lack a test id
actions.args: The path or glob the user gave, otherwise empty for the project's UI source.

next.when: the audit found elements missing a test id
next.subject: the same path

actions.label: Add missing test ids
actions.description: Writes stable data-testid attributes onto every interactive element that lacks one. One gate before any edit.
actions.args: The path or glob the user gave, otherwise empty for the project's UI source.

actions.label: Set up QA environments
actions.description: Asks which environments, login method and data rules qa-tester should use, and saves them. No secrets are stored.
